program_layer: scalable decoding with finite-size transition evidence
question: Under a matched directed pair-error channel with no rough-boundary syndrome or representation readout, does full interior fusion information reduce finite-size LER relative to interior-syndrome-only BP and ordinary syndrome-only matching, and do the resulting curves support a schedule-specific crossing estimate?

best_existing_decoder.name: directed full-record sum-product belief matching
best_existing_decoder.scope_limit: BP is exact on a factor tree only; loopy beliefs plus matching are not global MAP.

observation_arms.record: hard interior detector m only for recovery; prior weights

physical_channel.active_edge: stored arrow deposits antifundamental at tail and fundamental at head
physical_channel.rough_boundary_observation: neither m nor R is measured; both are marginalized in BP
physical_channel.interior_detector_syndrome: perfect and identical across all arms; it is the matching constraint

matching: All groups share graph, physical error, m, p, seed, and fusion-sampling uniform variates. Within a group, all three arms share the resulting interior R record; group changes the actual local likelihood and therefore the label distribution.

a7a_artifact_compatibility_gate.scalar_artifact_equivalence: Posterior, convergence, iteration, matching weights, correction, residual, and logical parity reproduce the artifact backend on fixed-seed fixtures.
a7a_artifact_compatibility_gate.batch_equivalence: Batch and scalar Numba posterior entries agree within 1e-12; convergence and iteration fields agree exactly.
a7a_artifact_compatibility_gate.throughput_scope: Batching may replace BP inference only. PyMatching remains per shot unless separately validated.
a7a_artifact_compatibility_gate.failure_rule: Any mismatch blocks LER sampling pending runner remediation; artifact defaults may not be retuned.

a7a_result.scope: 16 cells: None/U1/SU2/SU3 x square/honeycomb x L=5,9; eight fixed-seed scalar records per arm and 256 repeated records per batch.
a7a_result.interpretation: The production runner is calibrated to the accepted artifact decoder. This is not an LER or threshold result.

exploratory_preliminary.reason: Researcher requested an immediate visible curve before the full registered acquisition.
exploratory_preliminary.claim_boundary: Operational diagnostic only; it is excluded from A7b estimation, comparison, refinement selection, and threshold inference.

exploratory_512.claim_boundary: Exploratory curve only; excluded from A7b estimation, comparison, refinement selection, and threshold inference.

a7b_ler_scan.runs_only_if: A7a reproduces the frozen artifact decoder and establishes scalar/batch equivalence.
a7b_ler_scan.primary_estimator: Final-correction failure: nonzero detector residual or nontrivial logical parity of error XOR correction.
a7b_ler_scan.secondary_diagnostic: BP convergence and terminal message delta; neither gates LER because PyMatching consumes the final available beliefs.
a7b_ler_scan.uncertainty: Wilson 95% LER intervals and paired bootstrap for arm differences and crossing stability.
a7b_ler_scan.refinement_trigger: Only an adjacent p bracket with L=7/L=11 Wilson overlap or signed LER-difference change permits a separately registered five-point, 40000-shot refinement.
a7b_ler_scan.claim_boundary: At most a phenomenological finite-size, decoder/channel/schedule-specific crossing or bracket.

verification: Batch and scalar Numba posterior outputs agree to 1e-12 on every group/arm fixture.
None full-record equals None syndrome-only exactly.
Matched-arm truth and seed hashes are identical.
No boundary R appears in generated records, decoder inputs, or figures.
Raw output retains convergence, residual, and logical-parity outcomes; no failed BP run is removed.
Rendered LER result exposes the same raw data, intervals, group, arm, orientation, and boundary-observation scope.
prohibited_claims: benefit from any rough-boundary syndrome or representation measurement
next_action: A7a is passed. Do not launch A7b LER sampling without a renewed researcher instruction; when authorized, use the frozen artifact decoder unchanged.
